description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 coderet: from the nucleotide sequences of a file with feature tables (embl, genbank, refseq, gff2, gff3, ...) the coding sequences (the CDS features, joins as one sequence; files NAME.cds, sequences ACCESSION_cds_N), the messenger RNAs (mRNA features; NAME.mrna, _mrna_N), the translations (the /translation tag of the CDS features; NAME.prot, _pro_N) and the non-coding regions (what the CDS, mRNA and exon features leave; NAME.noncoding, _noncoding_START) are written, NAME being the first sequence in lower case. The tool returns the log of the program (the counts of every sequence), the files by name and the messages; cds, mrna, translation and nonCoding select the outputs and outputFormat is the sequence output format (fasta unknown pearson, gcg gcg8, nbrf pir, codata, strider, staden, text plain raw, ig iguspto, gde, fitch, acedb, mase, ncbi, gifasta, nib (nibble), dasdna, das, asn1, embl (em, emblnew, emold, emblold), genbank (gb, ddbj), refseq, genpept, refseqp, swiss (sw, swissprot, uniprot, swissnew, swnew, swold, swissold, swissprotold, swissprotnew), gff2, gff3 (gff), fastq (fastq-sanger, fastq-illumina, fastq-solexa: the quality values of the sequences are written), sam, scf, and the sequence-set formats msf, clustal (aln), selex, phylip, phylipnon (phylip3), hennig86, mega, meganon, nexus (paup), nexusnon (paupnon), jackknifer, jackknifernon, treecon (written when the output is closed), experiment, debug and bam (BGZF blocks deflated as zlib 1.3 does)). Equals the installed program on 1 000 runs (EMBL entries with joins, complements, orders, partial ends and translations, the reader inputs with features, damaged files, one to four outputs in 29 format names). A5-8c3h, B09 F259.

sequence.description: The text of the sequence file with features (nucleotide sequences), see the formats above.

sequenceFormat.description: The input format (-sformat); default: the program finds the format.

outputFormat.description: The sequence output format of the four outputs (-osformat3 .. -osformat6); default fasta.

qualifiers.description: Sequence input qualifiers as typed after the sequence on the command line: -sbegin1 -send1 -sreverse1, -slower1 -supper1, -sformat1 F, -sid1 name, -sdbname1 db, -squick1, -iquery1 query, -ioffset1 bytes.

files.description: More files by name (file name -> text) that sequenceValue may name.

sequenceValue.description: The USA of the sequence input (-seqall): [format::]file[begin:end:r], file:id, file:field:value, file{a|b}, @list, list::list, db:id; the text of sequence is the file 'sequence.dat'.

definitions.description: The text of an EMBOSS configuration file (.embossrc) that defines databases for sequenceValue: DBNAME definitions (methods direct, emboss and emblcd), RES / RESOURCE, SERVER, INCLUDE (the included file is an entry of files), IF / IFDEF / ELSE / ENDIF and SET blocks; the files of a database, and for the methods emboss (dbxfasta / dbxflat index files NAME.ent, .xid, .pxid ...) and emblcd (dbifasta / dbiflat files division.lkp, entrynam.idx, acnum.trg ...) its index files as latin-1 text, are entries of files by path.

outputSingle.description: Write every sequence of the four outputs to a file of its own, name.extension in lower case (-ossingle3 .. -ossingle6); the files are in files.

outputDirectory.description: The directory of the output files (-osdirectory3 .. -osdirectory6).

outputExtension.description: The extension of the output files (-osextension3 .. -osextension6); default cds, mrna, prot and noncoding.

outputName.description: The base name of the output files (-osname3 .. -osname6); default: the name of the first sequence in lower case.

log.description: The log of the program: the counts of CDS, mRNA, non-coding features and translations of every sequence.

messages.description: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors.message: Unable to read sequence ... (no sequence in the file) and Sequence is not nucleic (a protein file)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault, and an output format this port does not write, are refused

examples.name: The coding sequence and translation of an EMBL entry

input.sequence:
ID   X1; SV 1; linear; genomic DNA; STD; UNC; 60 BP.
XX
AC   X1;
XX
DE   test
XX
FH   Key             Location/Qualifiers
FH
FT   CDS             join(3..12,20..29)
FT                   /translation="MKV"
SQ   Sequence 60 BP; 15 A; 15 C; 15 G; 15 T; 0 other;
     acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt acgtacgtac gtacgtacgt        60
//
